after.zh: 0.5 是 PASCAL VOC 的标准；COCO 把 0.5 到 0.95 的十个门槛都算一遍再平均，框要画得更准才拿得到分。
after.en: 0.5 is the PASCAL VOC standard; COCO computes ten thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 and averages them, so boxes have to be drawn more precisely to score.

t.zh: 托盘里的<part-ref to="own-10-1"></part-ref>输出两个框掩膜的交并比：重叠面积除以合起来的面积。
t.en: The <part-ref to="own-10-1"></part-ref> in the tray outputs the intersection over union of two box masks: the overlap divided by the area they cover together.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：IoU 够大就算找对了，输出 1。
t.en: Your task in this level: if the IoU is large enough the detection counts as right; output 1.

brief.zh: 检测出的框和标注的框 IoU 大于 0.5 时输出 1，否则 0。
brief.en: Output 1 when the IoU of the detected box and the labelled box is above 0.5, otherwise 0.

label.en: A big box round a small one
